headline: GD Q2 Deep Dive: Aerospace and Shipyard Strength Drive Backlog to New Highs
summary: Aerospace and defense company General Dynamics (NYSE:GD) reported Q2 CY2026 results beating Wall Street’s revenue expectations, with sales up 8.1% year on year to $14.09 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $4.24 per share was 6.6% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
